relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of hypoxia-inducible factor-1α (HIF-1α), a crucial transcription factor that regulates angiogenesis and glycolysis, was also upregulated after CCI and inhibited by fumagillin.

relationships.subject: fumagillin
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal infusion of fumagillin significantly reduced the expression of angiogenic factors and glycolytic enzymes upregulated by CCI.

key_findings: Fumagillin reduced CCI-induced thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia and lowered spinal VEGF, ANG2, PKM2, LDHA and HIF-1α
VEGF and PKM2 were mainly in astrocytes, ANG2 and LDHA mainly in neurons of the dorsal horn
